//: Declared inputs of tooling-tests steps the walker cannot read whole (scripts/ci/tooling_steps.py): a shell script
that runs a file from a variable (`for t in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$t"`), or a run text that names no test.
Without an entry such a step runs on every pull request. With one, it runs when a changed path matches an input glob
(`**` crosses folders) or an input the walker resolved, and is skipped with the reason otherwise. A change to this
file runs every step. `tooling_steps.py verify --workflow W --job J` runs each declared step under strace -f and
fails on a checkout file it touched that neither its globs nor its resolved inputs cover

`"traced": true` (tooling_steps.py load_traced): its globs and the walker's resolved files are every path the step's traced run read (`verify` checks that), so they alone decide it; the walker's folder, whole-tree and spelled-name guesses are not consulted. A feat-cmux-next push is not pull_request, so tooling-tests runs every step there and a read the globs miss shows red on the base; rerun `verify` when a traced step's script changes.

tt-measure-tests.why: run-all.sh runs every scripts/measure/tests/*.test.sh and *.test.py by a loop variable; no-unattended-prompts reads every tracked file under scripts/ and .github/

tt-test-registry.why: its run text names a checker, not a test, so the walker resolves no test for it; traced, validate_test_execution_registry.py reads every workflow, action and tests/test_*.py, the tests/test-execution.d fragments, scripts/ci, ci/steps.toml and scripts/verify-local.py, and its git reads (diff and log of tests, archive of .github, tests, scripts/ci and scripts/verify-local.py at the base) name only those paths

tt-swift-test-coverage.why: its run text names a checker, not a test, so the walker resolves no test for it; traced, swift_test_coverage.py reads every Packages/*/*/Package.swift, CmuxNext's ci-target-graph.json and test folders, the workflows its registry names, its registry, the Linux package list, package-test-lane.sh and fast-tier.json; its git reads are CmuxNext's Package.swift at the base and the files added under CmuxNext/Tests

tt-pr-red-checks-comment.why: traced: the red-checks test reads its script, the workflows and two fixture helpers; nothing else in the tree

tt-fast-gates.why: traced: the fast-gates tests read scripts/ci, the workflows, the CI notes, the sidebar-owner plan, the parity notes, webviews' tsconfig and package.json, and `git ls-files -- webviews` filtered to *.test.*/*.spec.*; every git history read is in fixture repos
